answer: The beacon graph is validated at intake and the nectar frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and wander anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 20 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 4171 account sybil into a 13 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
